title: The Godfather
real: An aging crime patriarch hands his empire to his reluctant youngest son, who must harden himself to hold the family together.
fake: A mild-mannered botanist inherits his uncle's florist shop and discovers the flower business is run by rival mafia families.

title: Titanic
real: A penniless artist wins passage on the world's grandest ocean liner and falls for a society girl engaged to another man, days before the ship's fatal collision.
fake: A lighthouse keeper and a traveling circus performer fall in love while a storm strands their ships in the same harbor for a week.

title: Jaws
real: A resort town's summer season is threatened when a great white shark attacks swimmers, forcing a police chief, a scientist, and a salty fisherman to hunt it down.
fake: A seaside hotel's new chef must feed a fussy food critic while the town's annual sandcastle contest spirals out of control.

title: Jurassic Park
real: An eccentric billionaire brings dinosaurs back to life on a remote island theme park, and a visiting team must survive when the power fails.
fake: A zoo veterinarian inherits a safari park full of oversized reptiles and must teach them circus tricks to save it from foreclosure.

title: The Lion King
real: A young lion prince is exiled after his uncle seizes the throne, and he must return years later to reclaim his pride's kingdom.
fake: A city cat travels to the countryside to visit relatives and accidentally wins a county fair talent show with his singing.

title: Inception
real: A thief who steals secrets from inside dreams is hired to plant an idea in a target's mind, a job that requires building dreams within dreams.
fake: A locksmith who specializes in hotel safes is hired to hide a priceless gem inside a bank vault that only opens during thunderstorms.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
real: A banker wrongly sentenced to life in prison forms a quiet friendship and a decades-long plan to escape and reclaim his freedom.
fake: An accountant joins a monastery and discovers the order's books are decades out of balance, launching a gentle audit that changes the abbey.

title: Forrest Gump
real: A gentle man with a low IQ drifts through decades of American history, touching the lives of everyone he meets while chasing the girl he loves.
fake: A small-town mail carrier delivers letters to the wrong houses for forty years, unknowingly reuniting long-lost families.

title: Pulp Fiction
real: Two hitmen, a boxer, and a gangster's wife cross paths in a series of interlocking stories set in a seedy Los Angeles underworld.
fake: Three barbers in a quiet suburb discover their shop was built on a forgotten bank vault and plot a gentle heist between haircuts.

title: Spirited Away
real: A sullen ten-year-old girl wanders into a spirit world and must work in a bathhouse for ghosts to free her transformed parents.
fake: A schoolgirl's summer job at a seaside diner turns magical when the regulars turn out to be retired circus performers who speak only in riddles.

title: The Matrix
real: A hacker learns the world he knows is a computer simulation and joins a small crew of rebels fighting the machines that imprisoned humanity.
fake: A computer repairman discovers his town's power grid is secretly controlled by a rival repair shop and leads a neighborhood protest.

title: Schindler's List
real: A German businessman saves more than a thousand Jewish workers from the Holocaust by employing them in his factories during World War II.
fake: A factory owner in postwar Europe builds a chain of bakeries and accidentally becomes the region's most beloved radio sponsor.

title: Seven Samurai
real: A farming village hires seven masterless warriors to defend it from a band of raiders who return each harvest to steal the crops.
fake: A retired fencing master opens a school for village children and stages an annual tournament that unites rival farm families.

title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
real: A mysterious black monolith guides humanity's evolution, and a voyage to Jupiter goes wrong when the ship's computer begins killing the crew.
fake: A stargazing astronomer builds a giant telescope in his garden and discovers a small comet orbiting his own house.

title: Amélie
real: A shy Parisian waitress secretly improves the lives of people around her through playful schemes, until she must face her own happiness.
fake: A timid florist in Lyon spends her days rearranging customers' bouquets so that every delivery tells a tiny love story.
